product: ai_enrich can ground rows with external MCP search providers (Beta)
tagline: The ai enrich function can ground each row with a search tool on an external Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that you register in Unity Gateway, such as You.com or Exa.
what_it_does: The ai enrich function can ground each row with a search tool on an external Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that you register in Unity Gateway, such as You.com or Exa. Add an mcp knowledge source alone or alongside other knowledge sources in the same call. This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: Use ai enrich to add derived attributes to a table at scale.

capabilities.title: Simple schema: A JSON array
capabilities.desc: Simple schema: A JSON array of field names, which are generated as strings.

capabilities.title: Advanced schema: A JSON object
capabilities.desc: Advanced schema: A JSON object with type information, descriptions, and nested structures.

capabilities.title: Supports string, integer, number, boolean
capabilities.desc: Supports string, integer, number, boolean, and enum types. Performs type validation. Maximum of 500 enum values.
